parsed.refutation_attempt: The reported XSS vulnerability hinges on the premise that output to std::cout is rendered in a web browser, where injected HTML/JavaScript could be executed. In reality, std::cout writes to the standard output stream (typically a terminal or console). Console output is not parsed as HTML or JavaScript, so any embedded tags or scripts will simply be displayed as plain text and cannot be executed by a browser or other interpreter. No additional sanitization is required for this context. No untrusted source is propagated to a browser-rendered sink, so the conditions for XSS are not met.
